notes: This is a tail-distribution experiment, not a spacing/unfolding experiment.
Perron eigenvalue is saved but excluded from primary spectral-tail fits.
Spectral CCDF denominators use N-1, not the number of sparse eigenvalues retained.
final_upper_cap is a cap on expected weights, not a hard spectral bound.
tau_convention_resolution: tau is the experimental CCDF exponent P(W >= t) ~ t^-tau; the checked-in Chung-Lu baseline still uses density exponent, so this experiment calls it with effective tau = tau + 1
